author: DaiqingChen
body:
Checked all gene product from basement membrane (GO:0005604) from AmiGO 2026/10/20, found 95 genes not in our requested basement membrane gene list. Among those 95 genes, 47 are from the child term Non-collagenous component of basement membrane (GO:0140144), and requested to get removed in #6630 .

The remaining 48 genes were originally annotated to the basement membrane (GO:0005604) before our curation started. 

- 15 of them are gene products belong to the interstitial matrix, transmembrane, intracellular or the basement membrane/interstitial matrix interface. 
- 15 of them are gene products belong to Matrisome-associated Matrisome Division, that I am not sure where they usually locate at. Would be great if you know where those gene products should be located at @Matrisome 
- 18 gene products are not in the Matrisome list, not sure the function and why annotated to the basement membrane. Need further investigation.

The list of 48 genes not covered gene products attached here:
[261102_rmFrom_BM_list_Github.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34291439/261102_rmFrom_BM_list_Github.xlsx)
title: Remove gene products from basement membrane (GO:0005604)
